levels.3: high — baseline; comparison experiments / shared eval
levels.4: near-duplicate — same task or method (publication risk)

papers.title: Agentic Memory: Learning Unified Long-Term and Short-Term Memory Management for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Unified memory policy treating store/retrieve/update/summarize/discard as learnable agent actions optimized with RL.
papers.usage_note: Likely baseline; closest to HAT's end-to-end memory management beyond heuristics.

papers.title: Learning What to Remember: A Cognitively Grounded Multi-Factor Value Model for Agentic Memory
papers.summary: Learned multi-factor memory value function grounded in cognitive psychology (emotional intensity, goal relevance, reliability).
papers.usage_note: Likely baseline; directly addresses forgetting/prioritization central to HAT consolidation.

papers.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
papers.summary: Virtual context management with multi-tier memory and automatic migration across tiers.
papers.usage_note: Likely baseline; relevant to HAT's hippocampus-neocortex separation.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Verbal reinforcement learning: agents reflect on failures in natural language, store reflections in episodic memory, and reuse them.
papers.usage_note: Likely baseline; one of HAT's closest ancestors (fail -> reflect -> write -> reuse).

papers.title: Think-in-Memory: Recalling and Post-thinking Enable LLMs with Long-Term Memory
papers.summary: Stores and updates intermediate thoughts as evolving memory with insert/forget/merge operations and efficient retrieval.
papers.usage_note: Likely baseline; closely related to HAT's trace abstraction and memory lifecycle.

papers.title: Large Language Models Can Self-Improve
papers.summary: Selects high-confidence rationale-augmented outputs from unlabeled data and fine-tunes on them.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; foundational reference for selective consolidation/replay.

papers.title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
papers.summary: Early long-term memory framework for LLM dialogue emphasizing memory updates, selective forgetting, and reinforcement over time.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; forgetting-curve precursor to memory-value strategies.

papers.title: A Survey on the Memory Mechanism of Large Language Model based Agents
papers.summary: Systematic review of memory design and evaluation in LLM agents, covering core module patterns and open challenges.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; situates HAT's hippocampus-neocortex decomposition.

papers.title: MoT: Memory-of-Thought Enables ChatGPT to Self-Improve
papers.summary: Builds external memory from high-confidence pre-thinking traces and reuses it for test-time reasoning improvement.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; adjacent to turning traces into reusable learning assets.

papers.title: In Prospect and Retrospect: Reflective Memory Management for Long-term Personalized Dialogue Agents
papers.summary: Reflective memory management with prospective summarization and retrospective retrieval refinement via online RL.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; personalized-dialogue view of adaptive memory curation.

papers.title: Reinforced Self-Training (ReST) for Language Modeling
papers.summary: Offline self-training that generates policy data and improves models via iterative reinforcement-style updates with data reuse.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; replay-centric, sample-efficient consolidation perspective.

papers.title: ReST meets ReAct: Self-Improvement for Multi-Step Reasoning LLM Agent
papers.summary: Combines ReAct-style tool-using trajectories with ReST-like iterative improvement and self-distillation.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; wake-sleep-style loop converting traces into updates.

papers.title: Self-Adapting Language Models (SEAL)
papers.summary: Enables LLMs to self-adapt by generating their own finetuning data and update directives, trained with RL using downstream performance as reward.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; conceptually close, different mechanism.

papers.title: Selective Reflection-Tuning: Student-Selected Data Recycling for LLM Instruction-Tuning
papers.summary: Teacher-student collaboration for data refinement; teacher improves data quality and student selects compatible examples.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; addresses data selection central to selective consolidation.

papers.title: SELF: Self-Evolution with Language Feedback
papers.summary: Iterative self-evolution via self-feedback, self-refinement, and repeated fine-tuning on enhanced model-generated data.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; strongly related to HAT's closed-loop improvement.

papers.title: A Survey on Self-Evolution of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Comprehensive survey of self-evolution approaches in LLMs, framing the process as iterative cycles of experience acquisition, refinement, updating, and evaluation.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; aligns with HAT's experiential-learning vision.

papers.title: Self-Rewarding Language Models
papers.summary: Uses the model itself as a reward provider (LLM-as-a-Judge) within iterative preference optimization.
papers.usage_note: Relevant to HAT's future memory-importance scoring and autonomous quality evaluation.

papers.title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
papers.summary: Self-taught reasoning: iteratively fine-tune LLMs on self-generated solutions filtered for correctness.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; self-improvement loop aligns with wake-sleep consolidation.

papers.title: START: Self-taught Reasoner with Tools
papers.summary: Hint-infer and Hint Rejection Sampling Fine-Tuning for reasoning LLMs with tool invocation.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; self-learning + fine-tuning akin to replay-based updates.

papers.title: V-STaR: Training Verifiers for Self-Taught Reasoners
papers.summary: Extends STaR by training a verifier to judge solution correctness using both correct and incorrect solutions.
papers.usage_note: Compared in Related Work; verification complements HAT's uncertainty gating/triage.

papers.title: Awesome-Self-Evolution-of-LLM (Alibaba DAMO Reading List)
papers.summary: Maintained paper repository accompanying the self-evolution survey; high-value index for literature expansion.
papers.usage_note: Reference resource; not cited as a paper.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models for Image Quality Assessment via Voting and Ranking (EvoQuality)
papers.summary: Self-supervised fine-tuning of VLMs via pseudo-labels from pairwise voting and group relative policy optimization.
papers.usage_note: Weakly related; domain-specific, self-consistency principle only.

papers.title: Principle-Driven Self-Alignment of Language Models from Scratch with Minimal Human Supervision
papers.summary: Low-supervision self-alignment pipeline that synthesizes prompts, generates principle-guided responses, and refines the base model on self-generated data.
papers.usage_note: Weakly related; alignment focus rather than memory/continual learning.

papers.title: Transformer-Squared: Self-adaptive LLMs
papers.summary: Self-adaptation framework that adapts LLMs to unseen tasks in real time by selectively adjusting singular components of weight matrices. No memory or replay mechanism.
papers.usage_note: Weakly related; mention as online-weight-update contrast to replay-based consolidation.
